rationale: The effective parse already preserves one primary unit per admitted source path and separate units for the explicitly mixed high-risk standings.

Further reduction would merge source standings, erase evidence-class distinctions, collapse historical/current state, or normalize a live contradiction.

reported_result_standing_policy: Preserve gate-local result plus evidence-class/reproducibility ceiling exactly; committed audit does not imply independent replication.
